1341: through the Guru's Word He has come to dwell in the heart. ॥3॥
The Guru is all-powerful and ever merciful;
ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
chanting and chanting the Lord, Nanak, one is enraptured. ॥4॥11॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Dwelling on the Guru, the Guru, I have found lasting peace.
ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ; ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ. ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Merciful to the meek has become kind, and He Himself has led me to chant His Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Joining the company of the saints, one is enlightened;
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ; ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
chanting the Lord's Name, every hope is fulfilled. ॥1॥
All joy and peace have come to dwell in the mind;
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ; ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੂਠੇ ॥੨॥੧੨॥
the Lord's praises are sung when Guru Nanak is pleased. ॥2॥12॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
There is no other place of rest,
none at all without the Lord's Name.
In it are all spiritual powers and well-being;
through it all tasks are accomplished. ॥1॥
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਲਗੈ ਏਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Lust, anger and ego are destroyed, and one comes to love the One alone. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੈ. ਦੂਖੁ ਭਾਗੈ; ਸਰਨਿ ਪਾਲਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Attached to the Name, pain runs away; He is able to protect those who take His sanctuary.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ. ਜਮੁ, ਨ ਤੇਟੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
One who has such destiny written meets the true Guru, and death cannot touch him. ॥2॥
ਰੈਨਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਤਜਹੁ. ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮ ॥
Night and day meditate on the Lord; give up the mind's wanderings.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮ ॥੩॥
One with perfect destiny meets the Lord in the company of the holy. ॥3॥
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਖਾਦ ਬਿਨਸੇ; ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਆਪਿ ॥
The troubles of countless lives are erased; He Himself protects.
ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੩॥
He is mother, father, friend and brother; servant Nanak, chant the Lord's Name. ॥4॥1॥13॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Chant the Name of the all-pervading Lord.
ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ; ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਹੰ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Strife, suffering, greed, attachment and the fever of ego are destroyed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ, ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗਿ; ਮਨੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ. ਜਾਹਿ ਪਾਪ ॥੧॥
Give up self-conceit and cling to the saints' feet; the mind becomes pure and sins depart. ॥1॥
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਜਾਨੈ; ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੪॥
Nanak is a child who knows nothing; God, mother and father, is there to protect him. ॥2॥1॥14॥
The sanctuary of Your lotus feet is my support.
ਊਚ ਮੂਚ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਸਰਬ ਊਪਰਿ. ਤੁਹੀ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O lofty, vast, infinite Lord and Master, You alone are over all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦਾਰ; ਦੈਨਹਾਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੧॥
Support of the breath of life, Destroyer of pain, Giver of discerning wisdom. ॥1॥
ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਰਖਨਹਾਰ; ਮਨਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਕ ॥
Bow to the Protector; worship the One God in the mind.
ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨੁ. ਕਰਉ ਮਜਨੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫॥
I bathe in the dust of the saints' feet; Nanak, one thus obtains countless comforts. ॥2॥2॥15॥
1342: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Duality has gone mad, and has made the mind mad.
In false greed one has wasted life.
ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹੀ; ਫੁਨਿ ਬੰਧੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Maya clings again and again; nothing restrains it.
The true Guru has saved those in whom he implanted the Name. ॥1॥
ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਰੈ ॥
Neither does the mind die, nor does Maya die.
ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ. ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ; ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ. ਭਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only He who made all this knows; reflecting on the Word, one crosses the terrifying world-ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
but the Maya they love does not go with them.
Possessive attachment to Maya takes many colours;
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਕੋ ਸਾਥਿ. ਨ ਸੰਗੀ ॥੨॥
without the Name, no one is a companion. ॥2॥
ਜਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਖਹਿ; ਪਰ ਮਨੁ ਤੈਸਾ ॥
As one sees one's own mind, so one judges the minds of others.
As one's desires, so one's state.
As one's deeds, so the attachment one forms.
Seeking the true Guru's counsel, one finds the home of poise. ॥3॥
In music and melody the mind is caught in the love of duality.
With deceit within, one suffers terrible pain.
Meeting the true Guru, one gains understanding,
and remains lovingly attuned to the True Name. ॥4॥
Through the True Word one practises truth,
and through the True Word sings the Lord's praises.
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ; ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
He dwells in his own true home and attains the immortal state;
then he is glorified at the True Door. ॥5॥
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ; ਭਗਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Without serving the Guru there is no devotion,
though one may make countless efforts.
Ego and possessiveness are dispelled through the Word,
and the pure Name comes to dwell in the mind. ॥6॥
ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ; ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
In this world, the practice of the Word is the most excellent deed.
Without the Word, all else is the darkness of attachment.
Through the Word one keeps the Name enshrined in the heart;
through the Word come liberation, wisdom and the door to freedom. ॥7॥
There is no other Creator who watches over all;
the True One Himself is incomparable and infinite.
Through the Lord's Name one attains the sublime state.
Nanak, only a rare servant searches and finds Him. ॥8॥1॥
Attachment to Maya has spread over the whole world.
Seeing a beautiful woman, one is lured by lust;
love for children and gold keeps increasing.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
One counts everything as one's own; only the Lord is a stranger. ॥1॥
I chant such a chant on my rosary,
ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਰਹਰਿ; ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
rising above pain and pleasure, in unique devotion. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
O Treasure of virtue, no one has found Your limit.
Through the True Word one merges in You.
You Yourself created coming and going;
ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ; ਜਿਨ ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
they alone are devotees who fix their consciousness on the True One. ॥2॥
Wisdom and meditation on the Lord, free of desire —
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
without meeting the true Guru, no one knows Him.
His light pervades all the pools of the body.
I am a sacrifice to the embodiment of bliss. ॥3॥
Through the Guru's teaching one attains loving devotion,
and burns away ego from within through the Word.
1343: He restrains the wandering mind and holds it steady,
and enshrines the True Name within the mind. ॥4॥
The intoxicating wonders and amusements fall away;
the mind is won over by the Guru's teaching and attuned to the One.
Seeing Him, one quenches the fire with water.
Only one blessed with great fortune understands this. ॥5॥
Serving the true Guru, doubt is dispelled;
night and day one stays awake, lovingly attuned to the True One.
One knows only the One, and no other;
serving the Giver of peace, one becomes pure. ॥6॥
Awareness turns to service, reflecting on the Word;
subduing ego is chanting, austerity and self-discipline.
When the Guru makes one hear the Word, one is liberated while living;
true in conduct, one finds true peace. ॥7॥
The Giver of peace is the Remover of pain;
one can think of no other work.
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
One places body, mind and wealth before the Lord.
Says Nanak, I have tasted the supreme essence. ॥8॥2॥
ਨਿਵਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਭੁਅੰਗਮ ਭਾਠੀ; ਰੇਚਕ ਪੂਰਕ ਕੁੰਭ ਕਰੈ ॥
One may practise inner cleansing, raise the coiled serpent energy, and breathe in, out and hold the breath,
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹੀ; ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਬੂਡਿ ਮਰੈ ॥
but without the true Guru there is no understanding; deluded by doubt, one drowns and dies.
ਅੰਧਾ ਭਰਿਆ. ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਧੋਵੈ; ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥
The blind one, full of filth, washes again and again, but the filth within never departs.
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ. ਫੋਕਟ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਮਾ; ਜਿਉ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੈ ॥੧॥
Without the Name all rituals are useless, like a juggler deceived by his own illusion. ॥1॥
The six religious rites are the immaculate Name alone.
ਤੂ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are the ocean of virtue; I am full of faults. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਣੀ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Chasing after Maya's affairs, evil-minded, one does corrupt deeds.
ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦਾ; ਬੂਝਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
The fool shows himself off but does not understand the true work.
ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੋਲ ਖੁਆਰ ॥
His desires are in enticing Maya; the self-willed one is ruined by his own words.
ਮਜਨੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਚੰਡਾਲ ਕਾ; ਫੋਕਟ ਚਾਰ ਸੀਂਗਾਰ ॥੨॥
The outcaste's ritual bath is false, and all his adornments empty. ॥2॥
ਝੂਠੀ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ; ਕਰਣੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ॥
False is the mind's understanding; its deeds lead to strife and dispute.
ਝੂਠੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਹੰਕਰਣੁ ਹੈ; ਖਸਮ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
Within the false is egotism; he does not taste the Master's delight.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਹੋਰੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ; ਫਿਕਾ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
Without the Name, whatever else one does is insipid in taste.
ਦੁਸਟੀ ਸਭਾ, ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ; ਬਿਖੁ ਵਾਤੀ, ਜੀਵਣ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੩॥
In the company of the wicked one is ruined; their words are poison and their life is wasted. ॥3॥
ਏ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ; ਮਰਹੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
O you deluded by doubt, do not bring on your own spiritual death.
Serving the true Guru there is lasting peace.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ. ਕਿਨੈ, ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Without the true Guru no one has found liberation.
They come and go; they die and die again. ॥4॥
ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
This body is made of the three qualities of Maya;
ਸੋ ਸੇਵਹੁ; ਜਿਸੁ. ਮਾਈ ਨ ਬਾਪੁ ॥
So serve the One who has neither mother nor father,
and craving and self-conceit will depart from within. ॥5॥
ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ; ਤਹ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
Wherever I look, there I see Him.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
Without meeting the true Guru there is no liberation.
To keep the True One in the heart is the most excellent deed;
all else is hypocrisy, and the worship it earns brings ruin. ॥6॥
Duality departs when one recognises the Word.
Inside and outside, know only the One.
This is wisdom: the Word is the most excellent.
In duality, ashes fall on one's head. ॥7॥
To sing His praise is the excellent deed, through the Guru's teaching;
in the society of saints, reflect on His virtues and wisdom.
One who subdues the mind — know him to be dead while yet alive.
Nanak, by the grace of the Gracious One, he is recognised. ॥8॥3॥
1344: ਗੋਤਮੁ ਤਪਾ. ਅਹਿਲਿਆ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ ॥
Gautam was an ascetic, Ahalya his wife; seeing her, Indra was lured.
ਸਹਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਚਿਹਨ ਭਗ ਹੂਏ; ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
When his body bore the marks of a thousand vaginas, then he repented in his mind. ॥1॥
No one goes astray knowingly, O brother.
ਸੋ ਭੂਲੈ. ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ; ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He alone goes astray whom He Himself leads astray; he alone understands whom He makes understand. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰੀ ਚੰਦਿ. ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੈ; ਕਾਗਦਿ. ਕੀਮ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
Harichand, king and lord of the earth, gave so much in charity that its worth could not be written on paper.
ਅਉਗਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ. ਤ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਉ; ਕਿਉ ਨੇਖਾਸਿ ਬਿਕਾਈ ॥੨॥
Had he known it to be a fault, why would he have given? And why would he have been sold in the market? ॥2॥
ਕਰਉ ਅਢਾਈ. ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਂਗੀ; ਬਾਵਨ ਰੂਪਿ ਬਹਾਨੈ ॥
In the form of a dwarf, on a pretext, two and a half steps of land were begged;
ਕਿਉ ਪਇਆਲਿ ਜਾਇ. ਕਿਉ ਛਲੀਐ; ਜੇ ਬਲਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
had Bali recognised that form, why would he have been deceived and gone to the underworld? ॥3॥
ਰਾਜਾ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਦੇ ਮਤਂ‍ੀ; ਬਰਜਿ ਬਿਆਸਿ ਪੜੑਾਇਆ ॥
Vyas taught and warned King Janmeja with good counsel,
ਤਿਨੑਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਗ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਘਾਏ; ਕਿਰਤੁ. ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
yet he performed eighteen sacrifices and killed eighteen Brahmins; the record of past deeds cannot be erased. ॥4॥
ਗਣਤ. ਨ ਗਣਂ‍ੀ, ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ; ਬੋਲੀ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
I make no calculations; I recognise Your will, and speak with intuitive love.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ. ਤੁਧੈ ਸਲਾਹਂ‍ੀ; ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੫॥
Whatever happens, I praise You; all is Your greatness. ॥5॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ. ਲੇਪੁ ਕਦੇ, ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
The Guru-facing one is detached; filth never sticks to him; he remains forever in the sanctuary.
ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਗਧੁ. ਆਗੈ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਦੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੬॥
The self-willed fool does not think ahead; when struck by pain, he repents. ॥6॥
ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਚੀਐ ॥
The Creator who made this creation Himself acts and causes all to act.
ਹਰਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਅਹੁ; ਅਭਿਮਾਨੇ ਪੈ ਪਚੀਐ ॥੭॥
O Lord, pride does not leave the soul; caught in pride, one is ruined. ॥7॥
ਭੁਲਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ; ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ. ਨ ਭੁਲੈ ॥
Everyone is made to err; only the Creator does not err.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ; ਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਘੁਲੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
Nanak, deliverance comes through the True Name; by the Guru's grace a rare one escapes. ॥8॥4॥
To chant and hear the Name is my support;
The self-willed one, caught in duality, loses his honour.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
Without the Name, I have no other. ॥1॥
Listen, O blind, foolish, ignorant mind:
ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਲਾਜ. ਨਹੀ ਲਾਗੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਬੂਡੈ ਬਾਰੋ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
you feel no shame in coming and going; without the Guru you drown again and again. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
This mind is ruined by attachment to Maya.
ਧੁਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਤਾਂ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਾਸੁ ॥
The command was written from the beginning; to whom can one complain?
Only a rare one, through the Guru, understands
that without the Name there is no liberation. ॥2॥
Wandering and wandering, one staggers through the 8.4 million species.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝੇ; ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
Without understanding through the Guru, death's noose remains.
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ; ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
This mind rises to the sky one moment and falls to the underworld the next.
The Guru-facing one is released by dwelling on the Name. ॥3॥
When He Himself calls, there is no delay.
One who dies in the Word lives in ease.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ; ਕਿਸੈ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
Without the Guru no one understands;
He Himself acts and causes all to act. ॥4॥
One whose conflict He ends sings the Lord's praises;
through the perfect true Guru one merges in poise.
Then this wavering mind is held steady,
and one does the true work, making truth one's deed. ॥5॥
If one is impure within, how can one be pure?
Rare is the one who washes himself with the Word.
Rare is the Guru-facing one who practises truth;
his coming and going is checked. ॥6॥
1345: To make the fear of God one's food and drink is the most excellent peace.
In the company of the Lord's servants one reaches the far shore.
He speaks the truth, and love leads him to speak it.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਕਰਣੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
The Guru's Word is the most excellent deed. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ; ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
The Lord's praise is his ritual, his religion, his honour and worship.
He roasts lust and anger in the fire.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਤਉ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਾ ॥
When he tasted the Lord's essence, his mind was drenched with it.
Prays Nanak, there is no other. ॥8॥5॥
Chant the Lord's Name and worship Him within.
Reflect on the Guru's Word; there is no other. ॥1॥
ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਦੀਸੈ; ਕਿਸੁ ਪੂਜ ਚੜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I see no other; to whom should I make offerings? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਗੈ; ਜੀਅੜਾ ਤੁਝ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
My mind and body are placed before You; my soul is in Your hands.
As it pleases You, so keep me — this is my prayer. ॥2॥
One whose tongue savours the True Lord's essence
is released through the Guru's teaching in God's sanctuary. ॥3॥
My God created rituals and religious duties,
but He placed the glory of the Name above all rites. ॥4॥
The four great blessings are in the true Guru's power;
when the first three are absorbed, one is fulfilled in the One. ॥5॥
Those to whom the true Guru gave liberation and meditation
recognised the Lord's state and became honoured. ॥6॥
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Mind and body are cooled when the Guru imparts understanding.
Whom God has honoured — who can estimate their worth? ॥7॥
Says Nanak, the Guru has given me this understanding:
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਗਤਿ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੮॥੬॥
without the Name no one attains liberation. ॥8॥6॥
ਇਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਸਚੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
Some are forgiven by the Lord's primal will through the perfect Guru, who gives them a true make-up.
ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤੇ. ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਦੁਖ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Imbued with the Lord's love, they are forever in true love; their pain is forgotten and they obtain honour. ॥1॥
False is the cleverness of evil-mindedness;
ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ; ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
it takes no time at all to perish. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਵਿਆਪਸਿ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
Pain and suffering afflict the self-willed; following their own minds, their pain never departs.
ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ; ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
The Guru-facing know the Giver of pleasure and pain; He takes them into His sanctuary and unites them with Himself. ॥2॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਅਭ ਭਗਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਵਸਿ; ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚਹਿ ਦਿਵਾਨੇ ॥
The self-willed cannot perform single-minded devotion; maddened, they are consumed by ego.
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਊਭਿ ਪਇਆਲੀ; ਜਬ ਲਗਿ ਸਬਦ. ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ॥੩॥
This mind rises to the sky one moment and falls to the underworld the next, as long as it does not know the Word. ॥3॥
ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸਾ ਜਗੁ ਭਇਆ; ਤਿਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ. ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ॥
The world is hungry and thirsty; without finding the true Guru there is no satisfaction.
ਸਹਜੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥
Merging in poise, one finds peace and goes to the Lord's Court robed in honour. ॥4॥
ਦਰਗਹ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਇਕੁ ਆਪੇ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
In the Court, He alone is the Knower and Seer; this is understood through the Guru's pure Word.
ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ. ਸਚੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਸਿ; ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
The True One Himself hears and reflects; He Himself understands, and is master of the state beyond desire. ॥5॥
ਜਲੁ ਤਰੰਗ. ਅਗਨੀ ਪਵਨੈ ਫੁਨਿ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
Water, fire and air — these three combined to create the world.
ਐਸਾ ਬਲੁ ਛਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ; ਹੁਕਮੀ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥੬॥
He gave them such power and force, yet by His command He holds them in check. ॥6॥
ਐਸੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Rare in this world are those whom He tests and places in His treasury.
ਜਾਤਿ ਵਰਨ ਤੇ. ਭਏ ਅਤੀਤਾ; ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
They rise above caste and social class, and are rid of possessiveness and greed. ॥7॥
ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ. ਤੀਰਥ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
Imbued with the Name, they are pure places of pilgrimage; they have removed the pain and filth of ego.
ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੈ; ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੮॥੭॥
Nanak washes the feet of those who, through the Guru, love the True One. ॥8॥7॥
1346: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਵੇਖੁ ਤੂ; ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
By the Guru's grace, see: the Lord's temple is within you.
ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਖੋਜੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
The Lord's temple is found through the Word; keep the Lord's Name cherished within. ॥1॥
ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
O my mind, one imbued with the Word is dyed in His love.
ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ; ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
True is the devotion, true the Lord's temple; true glory is revealed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ; ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
This body is the Lord's temple; it is revealed through the jewel of spiritual wisdom.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਮਾਣਸਿ. ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
The self-willed do not know the Source; they think the Lord's temple cannot be within a human being. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਜਿਆ; ਰਖਿਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
The Lord Himself built the Lord's temple and keeps it adorned by His command.
ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
What is written from the beginning must be lived out; no one can erase it. ॥3॥
ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
Recognising the Word, one finds peace, in love with the True Name.
ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਣਾ; ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥
The Lord's temple is beautified by the Word, a fortress of gold for the Infinite. ॥4॥
ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ. ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਘੋਰੰਧਾਰ ॥
This world is the Lord's temple; without the Guru there is pitch darkness.
ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਦੇ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
The blind, foolish self-willed worship in the love of duality. ॥5॥
ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਤਿਥੈ ਦੇਹ ਜਾਤਿ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
Where the account is called for, neither body nor caste goes along.
ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ; ਦੁਖੀਏ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੬॥
Those imbued with Truth are saved; those in the love of duality suffer. ॥6॥
ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ; ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ. ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
The treasure of the Name is in the Lord's temple, but the ignorant fools do not understand.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਚੀਨੑਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
Those who recognised it by the Guru's grace keep the Lord enshrined in the heart. ॥7॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ. ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਤੀ; ਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Those who are lovingly imbued with the Word come to know the Guru's Word from the Guru.
ਪਵਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥
Those humble beings are holy, pure and immaculate, absorbed in the Lord's Name. ॥8॥
ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਾਟੁ ਹੈ; ਰਖਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
The Lord's temple is the Lord's shop, kept adorned by the Word.
ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਉਦਾ, ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੈਨਿ. ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥੯॥
In it is the one merchandise, the Name; the Guru-facing adorn themselves and take it. ॥9॥
ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ, ਮਨੁ ਲੋਹਟੁ ਹੈ; ਮੋਹਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
In the Lord's temple the mind is iron, enticed by the love of duality.
ਪਾਰਸਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ. ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਆ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
Meeting the philosopher's stone, it became gold, whose worth cannot be told. ॥10॥
ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
The Lord dwells in the Lord's temple; He pervades all, continuously.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਣਜੀਐ; ਸਚਾ ਸਉਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੧॥੧॥
Nanak, trade through the Guru, and the bargain is true. ॥11॥1॥
ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਜਾਗੇ, ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਾਗ੍ਰਣ ਕਰਹਿ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
Those awake in His fear and love keep the true vigil, removing the filth of ego.
ਸਦਾ ਜਾਗਹਿ. ਘਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਰਾਖਹਿ; ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰ ਕਾਢਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
They stay forever awake and guard their own home, and drive out and kill the five thieves. ॥1॥
O my mind, through the Guru meditate on the Name.
ਜਿਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਮਨ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O mind, do only those deeds on the path by which the Lord is found. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਊਪਜੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Through the Guru, the melody of poise wells up, and the pain of ego departs from within.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
The Lord's Name comes to dwell in the mind, singing the Lord's praises in poise. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਮੁਖ ਸੋਹਣੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching faces are radiant, keeping the Lord enshrined in the heart.
ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣਾ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
Here and hereafter there is great peace; chanting the Lord, they cross over. ॥3॥
1347: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਗ੍ਰਣੁ. ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ. ਨ ਪਵਈ ਥਾਇ ॥
In ego there is no true vigil, and devotion to the Lord is not accepted.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਰਿ ਢੋਈ. ਨਾ ਲਹਹਿ; ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
The self-willed find no shelter at His door; they act in the love of duality. ॥4॥
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਪੈਨੑਣਾ; ਜਿਨੑਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
Cursed is the eating and cursed the wearing of those in love with duality.
ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ. ਬਿਸਟਾ ਰਾਤੇ; ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੫॥
Worms in filth, absorbed in filth, they die and are reborn and are ruined. ॥5॥
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਤਿਨਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to those who have met the true Guru.
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾਂ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੬॥
May I remain in their company, absorbed in the Truest of the True. ॥6॥
ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
The Guru is found by perfect destiny; he cannot be found by any other means.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
From the true Guru poise wells up, and ego is burnt away through the Word. ॥7॥
ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ. ਭਜੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
Hurry to the Lord's sanctuary, O my mind; He is able to do all things.
Nanak, may the Name never be forgotten; whatever He does comes to pass. ॥8॥2॥7॥2॥9॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Mother, father, brothers, children and spouse —
together they peck their feed with delight.
The mind is entangled in sweet attachment.
Those who seek His virtues are the support of my life. ॥1॥
The One, the Knower of hearts, is mine.
ਧਰ ਏਕਾ. ਮੈ ਟਿਕ ਏਕਸੁ ਕੀ; ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He alone is my support; I lean on the One, the great Lord and Master, over the heads of kings. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਛਲ ਨਾਗਨਿ ਸਿਉ; ਮੇਰੀ ਟੂਟਨਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
I have broken with that deceitful serpent;
the Guru told me she is false and treacherous.
She is sweet in the mouth but bitter once eaten.
My mind remains satisfied with the nectar Name. ॥2॥
I have broken off with greed and attachment;
the merciful Guru has set me free.
This gang of thieves has ruined many homes;
the merciful Guru has saved me. ॥3॥
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸਿਉ; ਠਾਟੁ. ਨ ਬਨਿਆ ॥
I have nothing to do with lust and anger;
I have listened closely to the Guru's teaching.
Wherever I look, I see these terrible fiends;
my Guru, the Lord of the world, has saved me. ॥4॥
I have left the ten senses widowed;
the Guru told me their pleasures are a poisonous fire.
Whoever associates with them goes to the underworld;
ਹਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
the Guru has saved me, attuning me to the Lord. ॥5॥
I have stopped taking counsel with ego;
the Guru told me it is foolish and stubborn.
ਇਹੁ ਨੀਘਰੁ; ਘਰੁ ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Now it is homeless and finds no home anywhere;
ਹਮ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੬॥
the Guru has saved me, attuning me to the Lord. ॥6॥
ਇਨ ਲੋਗਨ ਸਿਉ; ਹਮ ਭਏ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
I have become estranged from these people;
ਏਕ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ; ਦੁਇ. ਨ ਖਟਾਂਈ ॥
the two cannot live together in one house.
Clinging to the Guru's robe, I have come to God:
O all-knowing God, give Your judgment. ॥7॥
God smiled and said, "I have judged."
He has set all the demons to serve me.
ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਇਹੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
"You are the master; this house is all yours."
Says Nanak, the Guru has settled the matter. ॥8॥1॥
1348: With anger and great ego in the mind,
one performs worship with great show,
bathes and marks the body with sacred symbols,
ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ; ਕਬ ਹੀ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
yet the filth within never departs. ॥1॥
ਇਤੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ, ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
No one has ever found God by such discipline;
ਭਗਉਤੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ; ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
one wears the marks of devotion to Vishnu, but the mind is enticed by Maya. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਾਪ ਕਰਹਿ; ਪੰਚਾਂ ਕੇ ਬਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
They sin under the power of the five,
bathe at a pilgrimage place and say all is washed away,
then commit the same again without hesitation,
and are bound and taken to the city of death for their sins. ॥2॥
Tying on ankle bells, they keep the beat,
but with deceit within they wander out of rhythm.
Closing the snake's hole does not kill the snake.
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ॥੩॥
God who created you knows everything. ॥3॥
He sits by fires and wears ochre robes;
ਅਪਦਾ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਿਆ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤੇ ਨਸਤਾ ॥
struck by misfortune, he runs from home,
leaves his own land and wanders abroad,
yet brings the five fiends along with him. ॥4॥
He splits his ears and covets scraps of bread;
ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਂਗੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਨ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਾ ॥
he begs from door to door but never finds satisfaction.
ਬਨਿਤਾ ਛੋਡਿ; ਬਦ ਨਦਰਿ, ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Abandoning his own wife, he casts an evil eye on others' women.
God is not found by religious garb; the soul only suffers more. ॥5॥
He does not speak; he sits in silence,
but desire is within, and he is made to wander through births.
ਅੰਨ ਤੇ ਰਹਤਾ; ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
He abstains from food and makes his body suffer;
he does not understand His will, and remains caught in possessiveness. ॥6॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥
Without the true Guru, no one has attained the supreme state;
ask all the Vedas and Simritis.
The self-willed one's deeds are in vain,
ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ; ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਈ ॥੭॥
like a house of sand that leaves no trace. ॥7॥
One on whom the Lord of the universe has been merciful
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ; ਤਿਨਿ. ਬਾਧਿਓ ਪਾਲਾ ॥
has tied the Guru's word securely to himself.
Such a saint is seen only rarely, one in millions;
in their company, Nanak is carried across. ॥8॥
ਜੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੁ; ਤਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
If one has such destiny, one obtains the sight of such a saint,
ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ; ਸਭੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਤਰਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
is saved oneself, and carries one's whole family across. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥2॥
Remembering the Name, all sins are cut away,
and the papers of the Righteous Judge's account are torn up.
Joining the company of the holy, one tastes the Lord's essence,
and the Supreme Lord comes to dwell in the heart. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Dwelling on the Lord, one has found peace,
seeking the sanctuary of Your servants' feet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Wandering has ended and darkness is dispelled;
the Guru has shown the door of liberation.
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਦ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
Mind and body are ever imbued with loving devotion to the Lord;
one knows only when God makes it known. ॥2॥
He pervades within each and every heart;
without Him there is no other.
Hatred, conflict, fear and doubt are cut away;
God, the pure soul, has shown His kindness. ॥3॥
One is brought to shore from the mighty waves;
separated for countless lives, one is joined again.
Dwelling on the Name is chanting, austerity and self-discipline,
for one on whom the Lord and Master has cast His glance of grace. ॥4॥
Joy, peace and salvation are there
1349: where the servants of the Lord of the world are.
God, the Lord of the world, is well pleased,
and the discord of countless lives is erased. ॥5॥
Burnt offerings, sacrifices, austerities hanging upside down, worship,
bathing at millions of pilgrimage places —
all are in enshrining His lotus feet in the heart for an instant;
meditating on the Lord of the universe, all one's affairs are resolved. ॥6॥
God's place is the highest of the high;
His servants fix their attention on Him in poise.
I long for the dust of the feet of the slaves of His slaves;
my Beloved is full of every power. ॥7॥
The Beloved Lord, mother and father, is near.
O Friend and Companion, You are my trust.
Taking them by the hand, You make Your servants Your own.
Nanak lives by chanting the Name of the treasure of virtue. ॥8॥3॥2॥7॥12॥
ਬਿਭਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The fear of death and birth is gone;
in His love He has revealed poise within. ॥1॥
The light has dawned and darkness is dispelled;
ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
reflecting, I have found the jewel of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Where there is bliss, pain has gone far away;
the mind becomes a jewel and, through attunement, holds the Essence within. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ; ਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
ਜੋ ਇਵ ਬੂਝੈ; ਸੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
one who understands this merges in poise. ॥3॥
Says Kabir, my sins have been erased,
and my mind is absorbed in the Life of the world. ॥4॥1॥
ਅਲਹੁ. ਏਕੁ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ; ਅਵਰੁ ਮੁਲਖੁ. ਕਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
If God dwells only in the mosque, to whom does the rest of the land belong?
ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ; ਦੁਹ ਮਹਿ ਤਤੁ. ਨ ਹੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Hindus say His Name dwells in the idol; in neither have they found the Essence. ॥1॥
O Allah, O Ram, I live by Your Name.
Show me Your mercy, O Master. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦਖਨ ਦੇਸਿ. ਹਰੀ ਕਾ ਬਾਸਾ; ਪਛਿਮਿ. ਅਲਹ ਮੁਕਾਮਾ ॥
The Hindu God dwells in the south, the Muslim God in the west.
ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਖੋਜਿ. ਦਿਲੈ ਦਿਲਿ ਖੋਜਹੁ; ਏਹੀ ਠਉਰ ਮੁਕਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
Search within your heart, deep within your heart; this is His home and dwelling place. ॥2॥
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨ ਗਿਆਸ ਕਰਹਿ, ਚਉਬੀਸਾ; ਕਾਜੀ ਮਹ ਰਮਜਾਨਾ ॥
Brahmins keep twenty-four fasts a year; the Qazis fast in Ramadan.
ਗਿਆਰਹ ਮਾਸ ਪਾਸ ਕੈ ਰਾਖੇ; ਏਕੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
They set aside the other eleven months, and seek the treasure in only one. ॥3॥
ਕਹਾ, ਉਡੀਸੇ ਮਜਨੁ ਕੀਆ; ਕਿਆ. ਮਸੀਤਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਂਏਂ ॥
What use is bathing at Orissa? Why bow your head in the mosque?
ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਪਟੁ. ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰੈ; ਕਿਆ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਂਏਂ ॥੪॥
With deceit in your heart you say your prayers; what use is going on pilgrimage to the Kaaba? ॥4॥
ਏਤੇ ਅਉਰਤ ਮਰਦਾ ਸਾਜੇ; ਏ ਸਭ ਰੂਪ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
All these men and women You have made are Your own forms.
ਕਬੀਰੁ ਪੂੰਗਰਾ. ਰਾਮ ਅਲਹ ਕਾ; ਸਭ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੫॥
Kabir is the child of Ram and Allah; all Gurus and Pirs are mine. ॥5॥
ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ. ਸੁਨਹੁ ਨਰ ਨਰਵੈ; ਪਰਹੁ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
Says Kabir, listen, O men and women: seek the sanctuary of the One.
ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ; ਤਬ ਹੀ ਨਿਹਚੈ ਤਰਨਾ ॥੬॥੨॥
Chant the Name alone, O mortals; only then will you surely cross over. ॥6॥2॥
ਅਵਲਿ ਅਲਹ ਨੂਰੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਬੰਦੇ ॥
First God created light; all beings are made by His creative power.
ਏਕ ਨੂਰ ਤੇ. ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ; ਕਉਨ ਭਲੇ. ਕੋ ਮੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
From the One Light the whole world welled up; so who is good, and who is bad? ॥1॥
1350: O people, do not wander deluded by doubt.
ਖਾਲਿਕੁ ਖਲਕ. ਖਲਕ ਮਹਿ ਖਾਲਿਕੁ; ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਂਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Creator is in the creation and the creation in the Creator, pervading all places. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਾਟੀ ਏਕ. ਅਨੇਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਿ; ਸਾਜੀ ਸਾਜਨਹਾਰੈ ॥
The clay is the same, but the Maker has fashioned it in many ways.
ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ; ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਪੋਚ ਕੁੰਭਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
There is nothing wrong with the clay pots, nor with the Potter. ॥2॥
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ. ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
The One True Lord abides in all; by His making everything is made.
ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੈ. ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨੈ; ਬੰਦਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
One who realises His command knows the One; he alone is called His servant. ॥3॥
ਅਲਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਗੁੜੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
God is unseen and cannot be seen; the Guru has given me this sweet molasses.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਮੇਰੀ ਸੰਕਾ ਨਾਸੀ; ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Says Kabir, my doubt is gone; I see the Immaculate Lord pervading all. ॥4॥3॥
ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ. ਕਹਹੁ ਮਤ ਝੂਠੇ; ਝੂਠਾ. ਜੋ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ॥
Do not say the Vedas and Semitic scriptures are false; false is the one who does not reflect on them.
ਜਉ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ. ਏਕੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਕਹਤ ਹਉ; ਤਉ ਕਿਉ, ਮੁਰਗੀ ਮਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
If you say the One God is in all, why do you kill the chicken? ॥1॥
O Mullah, you pronounce God's justice,
ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭਰਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but the doubt of your own mind has not left. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਕਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਨਿਆ, ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਮਾਟੀ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
You seize a living creature, destroy its body, and sacrifice the clay in God's name;
ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਨਾਹਤ ਲਾਗੀ; ਕਹੁ. ਹਲਾਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਆ ॥੨॥
but the light of the Imperishable abides in it — tell me, what have you made lawful? ॥2॥
ਕਿਆ ਉਜੂ. ਪਾਕੁ ਕੀਆ, ਮੁਹੁ ਧੋਇਆ; ਕਿਆ. ਮਸੀਤਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
What use is ritual washing, washing the face, bowing your head in the mosque?
ਜਉ ਦਿਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਹੁ; ਕਿਆ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
If you pray with deceit in your heart, what use is the pilgrimage to the Kaaba? ॥3॥
ਤੂੰ ਨਾਪਾਕੁ. ਪਾਕੁ, ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝਿਆ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
You are impure; you do not understand the Pure One, nor know His mystery.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਭਿਸਤਿ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਾ; ਦੋਜਕ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
Says Kabir, you have missed paradise; your mind is set on hell. ॥4॥4॥
ਸੁੰਨ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਤੇਰੀ. ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵਾਕਰ; ਅਧਪਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
O Divine Lord, Source of light, Master, primal and all-pervading — keeping the mind free of Maya is Your worship.
ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ; ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
Adepts in trance have not found Your limit; they cling to Your sanctuary. ॥1॥
ਲੇਹੁ ਆਰਤੀ, ਹੋ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
Perform the worship of the Immaculate Lord, O brothers, by serving the true Guru.
ਠਾਢਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ. ਨਿਗਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ; ਅਲਖੁ. ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Brahma stands studying the Vedas, but the Unseen cannot be seen. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਤੁ ਤੇਲੁ, ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤੀ; ਦੀਪਕੁ ਦੇਹ, ਉਜੵਾਰਾ ॥
With wisdom as the oil, the Name as the wick, and the body as the lamp, there is light.
ਜੋਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਜਗਾਇਆ; ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Applying His light, I have lit the lamp of the Lord of the world; only one who understands knows this. ॥2॥
ਪੰਚੇ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਾਜੇ; ਸੰਗੇ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਨੀ ॥
The five unstruck melodies resound, with the Lord of the world beside me.
ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾਸ. ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਕੀਨੀ; ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੫॥
Kabir Your servant has performed Your worship, O Formless Lord, beyond desire. ॥3॥5॥
ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ. ਮਨੁ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ; ਕੈ ਬੂਝਲ ਆਗੈ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
The mind's anguish only the mind knows; or tell it to the One who knows.
ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਾਂਈ; ਮੈ. ਡਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਚਹੀਐ ॥੧॥
I dwell on the Lord, the Knower of hearts; why should I be afraid? ॥1॥
The Lord of the world has pierced my heart.
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਵਿਆ; ਸਰਬੇ ਠਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My God pervades all places. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਾਨੈ ਹਾਟੁ. ਮਾਨੈ ਪਾਟੁ; ਮਾਨੈ ਹੈ ਪਾਸਾਰੀ ॥
The mind is the shop, the mind the town, and the mind the shopkeeper.
ਮਾਨੈ ਬਾਸੈ. ਨਾਨਾ ਭੇਦੀ; ਭਰਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
He of many forms dwells within the mind, yet the worldly wander about outside. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ. ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
When this mind is imbued with the Guru's Word, duality is absorbed into poise.
